labelled_by: Hand-labelled ground truth for the eval harness. Quotes are verbatim substrings of the transcripts.

quotes.quote: each one is an empty 45-minute slot I can't fill at the last minute.
The therapist sits there, unpaid time for the clinic.
when someone doesn't come I'm not earning anything for that hour but I still pay the room rent.
I calculated last year that missed appointments cost us around 18,000 euros.

pain_points.label: Manual reminder calls take a lot of staff time

quotes.quote: It takes her most of the afternoon, and half the time she gets voicemail.
I make about forty reminder calls every afternoon.

pain_points.label: Cancelled slots are hard to refill from a waiting list

quotes.quote: by the time we find someone on the list who can come in, the slot has passed.
When someone cancels, I want the slot offered to the waiting list automatically.

pain_points.label: Switching practice software is costly and feared

quotes.quote: I lost a weekend to exporting and re-importing patient files.
Changing software means retraining everyone and moving all the records.

H1.why: 4 of 5 describe no-shows as a major cost (C-05 quantifies 18,000 EUR/year); C-04 is the exception (3 percent no-shows).

H2.why: Younger and sports patients book online (C-02, C-03, C-04); older patients prefer the phone (C-01, C-05).

H3.why: Every clinic resists switching; they would only adopt something that works alongside current software.

H4.why: Cancellation fees are not discussed in any interview.
